QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, downloaded vehicle logs can be uploaded to Google Drive.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: autoLogUpload
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, every onboard log downloaded from the vehicle is automatically uploaded to Google Drive.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: folderName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Name of the Google Drive folder where logs are uploaded. The folder is created if it does not exist.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: clientId
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth 2.0 client ID of a Google Cloud 'Desktop app' OAuth client. Leave empty until credentials are provisioned.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: clientSecret
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth 2.0 client secret of a Google Cloud 'Desktop app' OAuth client. Leave empty until credentials are provisioned.
